profile_text.body:
Khosla Ventures is a for-profit firm founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Its website describes it as investing in the company best positioned to harness AI's exponential advances to build beneficial, human-aligned intelligence. The site also refers to backing a broad, category-defining finance workflow platform built on proprietary data and AI talent.

The site's own commentary covers several AI topics. It states that autonomous driving in closed systems is now easy to do and to deploy, and argues this should raise questions about new infrastructure projects involving old-school high speed rail. On economics, it says AI will transform economies and require a rethink of capitalism and equity, that the labor portion of the economy will decline sharply relative to capital, and that preferential capital gains treatment should be eliminated after 2028 and taxed as ordinary income, which it says could generate approximately $400B per year.

The company's recorded legal exposure is in California, with a count of 270. No products, MCP servers, or cases are recorded for it.
